title: pnpm override replaces a transitive range with a wildcard
description: pnpm-lock.yaml declares an override that forces a transitive dependency to accept any version. Every transitive consumer of the package resolves to whatever the registry publishes next, outside the top-level review entirely.
remediation: Pin the override to the version that was tested.
limitation: It matches an override that forces a transitive dependency to accept any version in the parsed pnpm-lock.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
